about: Findings of test_logos.ties()'s closer-dot rule (#379: another dot within 9 px of a logo box, or closer to it than the logo's own dot) on maps Erik approved, which the operator chose to keep as delivered rather than move (reddoor-workspace decisions/2026-11-17-1939-roalson-closer-dot-check-fails-approved-maps.md, answer (a)). Per listing and business as the map prints it: `findings` is the exact list the map must still have, no more and no fewer, so a map that changes fails. Only closer-dot findings can be listed. Read by build/test_logos.py approved(), which build/logo_check.py and test_logos.py's renders use.

findings: another dot (biz-dot) closer than its own
Walmart Supercenter.why: Costco's dot sits 6.6 px under the Walmart logo, whose own dot is 8.0 px away (#379). Erik approved the option C maps on 11-17: "The rest look good to me."

Costco.why: Ross's dot is 5.3 px from the Costco logo, which hangs on a line from its own dot (#379). Erik approved the option C maps on 11-17: "The rest look good to me."

findings: another dot (aadt-dot) closer than its own
